note_en: 才 before a verb means "only then": 我还要学习新的染发和烫发技术，才能跟上流行的变化 "I also have to learn new coloring and perm techniques; only that way can I keep up with the trends." It signals that the result depends on a condition being met first, as in 确认头皮没有伤口，才开始上药水 "only after making sure the scalp had no cuts did I start applying the solution." English needs "only then" or "not until," while Chinese packs that meaning into one adverb placed right before the verb.
